title: Make a reusable template
goal: Make one strong admin template with clear blanks — saved and ready to reuse next week.

blocks.title: Let's build your first template
blocks.body:
Pick one message you send over and over — a fee reminder, a class notice, your meeting-notes format, a permission form.

Describe it once. AI drafts a clean template with clear [blanks] you fill each time. Copy it into your email or a Google Doc, and it's yours to reuse. You stay the editor — tweak any line that doesn't sound like you.

blocks.scaffold: Make a reusable {{artifact}} for a {{gradeBand}} school about [recurring situation]. Use clear [blanks] for the details that change each time (like class, date, item), keep the tone warm and clear, and keep it short enough to reuse quickly. No student names.

blocks.question: How usable is the template you just saved — would you send it after a quick edit?
